meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把一份文档交给 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,存在源文件旁(如 report-slides.pdf);若配好密钥,还会上传服务器换回手机端分享链接。只做幻灯片,不做视频或播客。
howto.when: 当你提到“wowerpoint this”“turn this report into slides”等说法,或要求把某一份文档做成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把 reports/2025-q1.md 做成幻灯片
用温暖清晰的 kawaii 角色把这份文档做成 deck
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传给 NotebookLM

say.text: 换个提示词重新生成一版幻灯片
say.note: 复用已有 notebook 和 source,只重跑生成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude feeds a single document to NotebookLM and gets a kawaii slide-deck PDF saved next to the source (e.g. report-slides.pdf); with API keys set, it also uploads it for a mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “wowerpoint this”, “make a deck about <file>”, “turn this report into slides”, or otherwise ask to turn one document into shareable narrative slides.

say_en.text: Deck this document with warm, clear kawaii characters
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim

say_en.text: Regenerate the deck with a different prompt
say_en.note: Reuses the existing notebook and source
